**ADR-0030 reachability amendment draft (#629)**

ADR-0030 records nothing about who can REACH the mechanism: 0 mentions of mirror/firewall/air-gap/proxy/offline/registry access. Its Consequences say 'no credential and no repository access' — true and incomplete, since it requires registry access, which the git URL did not. Measured the escape hatch instead of assuming it: installed HEAD over git+file:// into a clean fixture — 433 files, 5.5 MB, files honoured, .memory/openspec/test/docs/.brain-source/.git all absent, works under private:true, lands under the package.json name so post-rename both transports resolve to the same directory. Wrote a brain-amendment/1 draft with 4 in-place edits; verified every anchor against the real target (f:1 r:0 each) and planAmendment renders 7 acts all pending. Lesson: planAmendment act 3's 'after' is contract.bodyHeading, a DISPLAY LABEL not the body — read as evidence it looks like a 76-char truncated section. Inspected extractBody directly instead: 3715 chars, correct boundaries. Issue #629.
